就在陈辰想着这些的时候，队长结束通讯回到自己身前，轻轻摆了摆手：“时间很紧迫了，带上他继续前进，争取在明天之内找到飞机。

不过，随着一人一龙缓缓地降落，此时原本安静的阵营也开始了骚乱。

而随后，猛然有出现了一股舆论，一条有近百名各行会管理、工作室头目、黑暗阵营名人玩家著名的帖子被迅速置顶。

男子的话语虽然不是很大声。但是却好像有一种魔力一样，让众人听了之后忍不住发自内心的去认同他，而这种能力毫无疑问便是传说之中的领袖魅力，同样的这也是这个男子可以聚集到如此多战力的根本原因。

旋即眼前景象转换，又回到了现实中，只见眼前海水沸腾，完全汽化成了白色的蒸汽，一大片爆炸的火光四下飞舞，犹如一颗耀眼的太阳在眼前升起。

因为阿尔托莉雅没有说话，所以李林也就没有继续解释下去，然而这个时候他去发现了梅林有些不对劲，不过出于对自己这个仆人的信任李林并没有说些什么，只是给了梅林一个眼神警告，让她不要去想那些有的没有的事情。

陈辰赶紧找了一片草丛，俯身藏在了里边，明晃晃的灯光从草上扫过，但那些士兵并没有发现他就藏在里边，所有人急着前行，并不知道一举一动都被陈辰看在眼里。

“对不起了姐姐，这次……嘿嘿嘿，我站在绯云姐姐这边。”萧梦羽果断叛变投敌。

在撤退的时候，陈尹实际上就是在故作姿态，骑士并不是他不想打了就跑，但亡灵复生术和收集尸体，都是需要花费时间的，所以与其这样，不如做出一个自己不惧怕任何攻击的姿态来。

“滚！”郑易手里的炮狙枪管敲向心魔兄的后脑勺，心魔兄现在还在虚弱阶段，居然没有躲过去，于是两人同时感觉了后脑轻轻一疼。

另一边，月儿看到韩烟柔这样子，也猜到她知道了事情的真相，眼里心疼的同时，亦是闪现着担忧。

但是他的心里却是怒火滔天，今天低头，日后一定找回来，不弄死方正，他就不叫方彻。

“报官？呵~仙道真是说笑了。如果报官就能解决问题，奴又何必让青让去千佛寺避难？”沉璧有些好笑的望着对方，果真是不沾俗尘的修仙之人，哪里懂得红尘里的人情世故。

Just when Chen Chen was thinking about this, the captain ended the communication and returned to him, waving his hand gently: "Time is running out, take him and move on, and try to find the plane within tomorrow.

However, as one person and one dragon slowly landed, the originally quiet camp also began to commotion.

Then, suddenly there was a wave of public opinion, and a famous post involving nearly a hundred guild managers, studio leaders, and dark camp celebrity players was quickly pinned to the top.

Although the man's words were not very loud.But there seems to be a kind of magic power that makes everyone unable to help but identify with him from the bottom of their hearts. This ability is undoubtedly the legendary charisma of leadership. It is also the fundamental reason why this man can gather so much combat power.

Immediately, the scene in front of him changed and he returned to reality. The sea water in front of him was boiling and completely vaporized into white steam. A large exploding fire was flying in all directions, like a dazzling sun rising in front of his eyes.

Because Artoria didn't speak, Li Lin didn't continue to explain. However, at this time, he went to find something wrong with Merlin. However, out of trust in himself as a servant, Li Lin didn't say anything. He just gave Merlin a look to warn her not to think about those things that were not there.

Chen Chen quickly found a patch of grass, leaned down and hid in it. The bright lights swept across the grass, but the soldiers did not notice that he was hiding inside. Everyone moved forward in a hurry, not knowing that Chen Chen was watching every move.

"I'm sorry, sister, this time...hehehe, I'm on Sister Feiyun's side."Xiao Mengyu decisively rebelled and surrendered to the enemy.

When retreating, Chen Yin was actually pretending. The knight did not want to fight and run away, but the resurrection of the dead and collecting corpses took time, so instead of doing this, it was better to pretend that he was not afraid of any attacks.

"Get out!"The barrel of the cannon sniper in Zheng Yi's hand hit Brother Xin Mo on the back of the head. Brother Xin Mo was still in a weak stage and did not hide away, so the two of them felt a slight pain in the back of their heads at the same time.

On the other side, Yue'er saw Han Yanrou like this and guessed that she knew the truth of the matter. While her eyes were distressed, there was also worry.

But his heart was full of rage. If he bowed his head today, he would definitely get it back in the future. If Fang Zheng was not killed, he would not be called Fang Che.

"Reporter?Haha~Xian Dao is really joking.If reporting to the official can solve the problem, why should I let Qingrang take refuge in Qianfo Temple?"Shen Bi looked at the other party in a funny way. He is really a cultivator who is not involved in the secular world. How can he understand the human world and sophistication in the mortal world.
